description: This file contains a custom culture info object for Slovenian (Slovenia) for the Date.js library, defining localized date and time formats, day and month names, regex patterns for parsing, and date manipulation functions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components (hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds) of a date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of a date object to the current system time.
